text: Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin (the whole Council) devised a plan. They bound Jesus (YHWH saves), led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate (armed with a spear).
So Pilate (armed with a spear) questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews (people of praise)? “You have said so, Jesus replied.
And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
Then Pilate (armed with a spear) questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look (behold) how many charges they are bringing against You!
But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus (YHWH saves) made no further reply.
Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people \Now at the feast he would release to them/ a prisoner of their choosing.
And a man named Barabbas (Son of Abba) was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
“Do you⁺ want me to release to you⁺ the King of the Jews (people of praise)? Pilate (armed with a spear) asked.
For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.
But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas (Son of Abba) to them instead.
So Pilate (armed with a spear) asked them again, “What then do you⁺ want me to do with the One you⁺ call the King of the Jews (people of praise)?
And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!
“Why? asked Pilate (armed with a spear). “What evil has He done? But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!
And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate (armed with a spear) released Barabbas (Son of Abba) to them. But he had Jesus (YHWH saves) flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on His head.
And they began to salute Him: “Hail, King of the Jews (people of praise)!
They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
After they had mocked Him, they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him.

Now Simon (hearing) of Cyrene, the father {patera} of Alexander (defending men) and Rufus (red-haired), was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.
There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
And they crucified Him. They also divided His garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take <Psa 22:18>.
It was the third hour (9:00 AM) when they crucified Him.
And the charge inscribed against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS (people of praise).
Along with Jesus, they crucified two robbers (insurrectionists), one on His right and one on His left. [28 So the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “And He was numbered with the transgressors.”]
And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads and saying, “Aha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
come down from the cross and save Yourself!
In the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves, saying, “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
Let the Christ (the Anointed One), the King of Israel (He wrestles with God), come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe! And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him.
From the sixth hour until the ninth hour (from noon until 3 pm) darkness came over all the land.
At the ninth hour, Jesus (YHWH saves) cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani? which means, “My God {Theos}, My God, why have You forsaken Me <Psa 22:1>?”
When some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, “Behold (behold), He is calling Elijah (my God is YHWH).

And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine (wine vinegar). He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink <Psa 69:21>, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah (my God is YHWH) comes to take Him down.
But Jesus (YHWH saves) let out a loud cry and breathed His last.
And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how [having cried out,] He had breathed His last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God {Theou}!

And there were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary (beloved) Magdalene (of Magdala), Mary the mother of James (supplanter / follower) the younger and of Joses (Joseph), and Salome (peace).
These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee (circuit), and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem (city of peace) with Him.
Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),

Joseph (he will add) of Arimathea (High place), a prominent Council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of God {Theou}, boldly went to Pilate (armed with a spear) to ask for the body of Jesus (YHWH saves).
Pilate (armed with a spear) was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph (he will add).

So Joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of Jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
Mary (beloved) Magdalene (of Magdala) and Mary the mother of Joseph (Joses) saw where His body was placed.
